Definition: Chiram or Chirom, the name of two Tyrians
BiblicalUsage: Hiram, Huram = "noble"; 1) the king of Tyre who sent workmen and materials to Jerusalem to build both the palace for David and the temple for Solomon; 2) the chief architect and engineer of Solomon's temple sent by King Hiram to Solomon
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
